verdict.rationale: Metronome supports event-driven automation via webhooks that fire on events like contract creation, threshold reached, or invoice finalized, and has built-in triggers like auto-recharge when credits run out — but this is limited to a fixed set of system events and outbound notifications rather than a general-purpose rules engine where users define arbitrary conditions and actions. missing for 10: user-defined conditional logic/rules builder, arbitrary custom actions beyond webhooks/recharge, independent evidence of real-world automation use.
